{{Top|leg}}
'''Rannagourds''' were a [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]]. [[Russo Berlihat]], newly in the service of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor (Moff)|Bandor]] on [[Questal/Legends|Questal]], was assigned to take a plate of rannagourds and [[balka greens]] to his [[Protean]] prisoner. Belatedly, Berlihat realized that he was the Protean's actual meal, not the vegetables.<ref name="SS">{{JournalCite|12|Shape-shifters}}</ref>
